title: Another Google Deepmind researcher quits, says building superintelligent AI soon is "inherently irresponsible"
summary: Google Deepmind researcher Robert O'Callahan has quit, saying AI's "current rate of change is far too high." He worked on chip design tools that helped make AI cheaper and faster, a contribution he can no longer justify. Many colleagues share his concerns but rarely speak out, he says.
